description.text: This major cultivates and practices the socialist core values, has good ideological quality and moral norms, adapts to the development needs of the local economy and the automotive industry, has a solid basic knowledge, basic theories and methods of economics, international economics and international trade trade, is familiar with the prevailing international economic and trade rules and practices, understands and grasps the operation mechanism and development law of international economy, international trade and trade-related financial services, has strong practical operation ability and certain analytical research ability, and can be in industrial and commercial enterprises, Financial institutions, government departments, etc. are engaged in international trade, banking, investment and financing, administrative management and other work related to the application of professionals.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Hubei University Of Automotive Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Copy of Passport and Photo; 2.Diploma, Certificate and Transcript; 3.Bank Statement; 4.Application form 5.Physical Examination Report; 6.Police Clearance

requirements.text: High school certificate, aged between 18 and 25 for bachelor application Bachelor Diploma,aged between 20 and 35, HSK4 for master application
